name: @hwfee/dsh-git-bash
description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git Bash 默认 shell：把 Windows 上的默认命令解释器从 PowerShell 换成 Git Bash，并暴露一个 run_shell 工具。自动从 git --exec-path 定位 Git Bash（WSL 的 bash 不算），找不到时降级而不是让插件消失。 / Git Bash as the default shell for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: resolves Git Bash from `git --exec-path` (never the WSL stub), exposes a run_shell tool, and degrades visibly instead of vanishing when the shell is missing.
author: HwFee <1744567281@qq.com>
